remarks: Rarely does a home in Wilton offer true first-floor living with this level of renovation, layout, and neighborhood setting. Completely updated with a designer's eye, this Colonial is tucked into one of Wilton's most sought-after streets, just minutes to downtown, Metro North, the Wilton YMCA, schools, parks, and more. The main-level primary suite is a standout with a renovated spa bath featuring heated floors, soaking tub, oversized marble shower, and custom walk-in closet. The chef's kitchen anchors the home with a massive quartz island, 6-burner gas range, Walker Zanger backsplash, farmhouse sink, and seamless flow to both indoor and outdoor entertaining. The vaulted great room with shiplap, built-ins, and backyard access is where everyone naturally gathers. A separate office with built-ins plus an additional first-floor en suite bedroom with private entrance offers flexibility for guests, au pair, or in-laws. Upstairs are two spacious bedrooms, storage, craft room, and hangout/homework space. Finished lower level with wet bar adds even more usable space. Outside, enjoy the large bluestone patio and beautifully landscaped yard, perfect for summer dinners, morning coffee, or simply enjoying the neighborhood setting. This is the kind of Wilton home buyers wait for: updated, functional, full of character, and in a neighborhood people rarely want to leave.
